hooks.name: Auto-commit after task

action.prompt: After a task, first run pnpm --filter @necro/oracle build, then pnpm -r typecheck and pnpm -r test (every package). If the full suite is green, git add all task changes since the last commit (never .env* or secrets; stage specific files, not git add -A) and commit with the message "Spec 02 tasks <first id>-<last id>: <summary>" covering every completed task since the last commit. Do not push. If the suite is red ONLY because of planned test-first failures (missing modules or assertions for code not yet implemented), do not commit and continue. If it is red for any other reason, do not commit; fix it first.

hooks.description: Commit when the full suite is green; skip on planned test-first red
